description:
Awesome ride quality of steel tubes and a classic slim look - this is the frame to go for if you love cromoly. We have years of experience in building steel dirt frames and believe that this is one of the best out there.The Majesty has been on the podium at world class dirt and slopestyle events more often than any other frame in the world. We used a totally high-end tube-set with offset multi butting and a rarely seen, full heat treatment process that takes place after the welding is finished. This technology allowed us to make one of the strongest dirt jumping frames on the market. What's more, every Majesty is covered inside and outside with a thin, weightless electroplated layer that protects it from corrosion. The Majesty frames are available in one version only - Dirt version with a low bottom bracket, ideal for high speed trails and big slopestyle courses. It also works better with higher forks (up to 140mm travel). We use fully removable cable guides flush with the tubes giving this frame unique, ultra clean look. The Majesty features fancy arched lost wax seat stays bridges with a 3D logo that look sweet & give lot's of tire clearance. This is really the ultimate cromoly dirt jumping frame. Now comes with a tapered head tube and gyro tabs.
REVISED FOR 2020
- removable gyro tabs
- threaded 73mm BSA BB (allows to install all lighweight mtb cranksets)
- improved tire clearance
MAIN FEATURES
- Tapered integrated headtube
- one of the strongest dirt frames on the market
- ride quality & classic slim look for chromoly frame lovers
- totally high-end tubeset, multi butted Tange cromoly
- fully heat treated after the welding
- gyro tabs included
